mainText: Three UN peacekeepers were killed in south Lebanon within 24 hours during Israel-Hezbollah conflict.
The United Nations reports two peacekeepers killed in an explosion in south Lebanon.
President Trump stated he could seize Iran's Kharg Island as the United States increases troop presence in the Middle East.
President Trump stated he has no objection to a sanctioned Russian oil tanker delivering relief supplies to Cuba despite the blockade.
Israeli police blocked Latin Patriarch Pierbattista Pizzaballa from attending Palm Sunday mass in Jerusalem.
